title.zh: 【瑞士监管机构批准该国首支比特币 ETF】
title.en: 【瑞士监管机构批准该国首支比特币 ETF】

current_state.zh: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first publicly offered exchange-traded fund investing directly in bitcoin, classified as an alternative investment fund with special-risk labeling and a waiver from diversification rules, with more providers preparing similar filings.
current_state.en: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first publicly offered exchange-traded fund investing directly in bitcoin, classified as an alternative investment fund with special-risk labeling and a waiver from diversification rules, with more providers preparing similar filings.
